x.description: array_like, MaskedArray The array to operate on. If not a MaskedArray instance (or if no array elements are masked), `x` is interpreted as a MaskedArray with `mask` set to `nomask`. Must be a 2D array.
constraints: x and output must have broadcast-compatible shapes.

axis.description: int, optional Axis along which to perform the operation. Default is None.
constraints: Must satisfy -rank(input) <= axis < rank(input) if provided.
